description: Argument check order of ODDFPRICE, ODDFYIELD, ODDLPRICE and ODDLYIELD: one argument out of its domain (a date below 0 or past 9999-12-31, settlement not before maturity, issue after the first coupon, a coupon date after maturity, ODDL* settlement before the last coupon, negative rate, negative yield or a zero price, zero redemption, frequency 3, basis 5) against an error or text in every other position (T-2483).
